$description: UberTib motion. Subtle feedback only. Motion confirms that something committed or that a disclosure opened, and does nothing else. Three things argue against choreography here and all three are canonical: weak and intermittent connectivity, an interruption-prone panel, and a React Native runtime on modest devices. Every preset declares its reduced-motion equivalent, and that equivalent preserves the feedback while removing the travel. The literal scale lives under primitive; everything else composes from it.

instant.$description: No transition. What every preset collapses to under reduced motion unless it names a fade.

fast.$description: Colour, opacity and border changes on a control the user is touching.

base.$description: Default. Disclosure, chip change, inline validation.

deliberate.$description: The ceiling. Nothing in this product animates for longer, and nothing may be added that does.

standard.$description: State changes on an element that stays in place.

linear.$description: Determinate progress only, where non-linear motion would misreport how much is done.

transition.$description: The complete set. A surface composes from these; it does not invent a timing.

control-feedback.$description: Hover, focus, pressed and selected changes on a control. Reduced motion: instant, and the colour still changes.

disclosure.$description: Progressive disclosure opening or closing. Reduced motion: instant, and the disclosed region is still announced.

state-change.$description: A status chip changing after a committed mutation. Never runs optimistically: the chip changes when the server has committed, not when the user pressed. Reduced motion: instant, with a live announcement.

overlay-enter.$description: Modal, drawer, sheet and popover arriving. Reduced motion: fade only, at the fast duration, with no travel.

overlay-exit.$description: The same surfaces leaving, deliberately faster than they arrived. Reduced motion: instant.

progress.$description: Determinate progress advancing - evidence transfer, provider search. Reduced motion: the bar still updates, it just does not tween.

reduced-motion.$description: Not an afterthought and not a global animation kill switch. Feedback that carries meaning must survive; only travel is removed. A user who cannot see a transition still has to know that a transfer resumed or that a plan was accepted.

duration.$description: Substituted for every duration except where a preset names a fade.

fade.$description: The one motion kept under reduced motion, for overlay entrance, so a surface does not appear without warning.

prohibited.$description: An endless spinner is prohibited as the only feedback for a mutation on any platform, reduced motion or not. The honest states are pending, failed, retrying and completed, and an idempotent safe retry replaces a spinner that never ends.
